meaning: fried dough wrapped in rice roll
usage: 炸兩 is used as a noun to refer to a specific dim sum dish.
You can use 炸兩 as the subject or object in a sentence.
When ordering at a restaurant, you might say 我想食炸兩 (I want to eat fried dough wrapped in rice roll).
炸兩 can be combined with measure words like 碟 (dish) or 份 (portion).
It is commonly mentioned in food conversations and menus.
